metadata.title: Retro Blue Studio Portrait with Inline Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A full-body portrait of a subject in white clothing against a solid cobalt blue studio backdrop with stacked, stylized typography in the upper left.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical full-body portrait of a man with dark curly hair and a beard, wearing an all-white outfit, positioned on the right side of a solid, vibrant blue field. The left side features two lines of text: a large, outlined serif name and a smaller, slanted script title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third of the frame
Typography anchored in the upper left quadrant
High contrast between white clothing and deep blue background
Diagonal flow from top-left text to bottom-right subject feet
coreInvariants: Inline/outlined serif display font for the primary name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject standing on the far right, occupying approximately 25% of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white outlined text in the top left corner acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, across the negative space, to the subject's face on the right, then down the length of the white outfit.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive blue negative space in the center and bottom left creates a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for clothing and text outlines
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark hair and beard providing a focal point
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation blue with high value white elements creates a clean, punchy look.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to blue, white, and natural skin/hair tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy serif with an internal inline stroke
Secondary text uses a connected, slanted brush script
Both text elements feature a subtle drop shadow or offset to pop from the blue
characterSpecificRedesigns: Inline strokes must follow the outer contour of the serif glyphs exactly
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a structured, geometric serif and a fluid, organic script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule or underline effect created by the script's slant

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual slanted script feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a man with curly hair and a beard wearing a white t-shirt and white trousers, standing on the right side of a solid cobalt blue background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large white outlined serif font in the top left. Below it, add the title in a white slanted script font.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is the subject wearing all white?
Is the text positioned in the upper left?
Does the primary text have an inline or outlined effect?

mustRedesign: Any background elements other than solid blue
Dark colored clothing on the subject

avoid: Low contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the subject is fully on the right side
Verify the script text is slanted upwards
Ensure the blue background is uniform
Confirm the white clothing is bright and clean
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Color Backdrop + High Contrast White Subject + Stacked Retro Display Typography
